CFLAGS="-EL -march=mips1 -msoft-float -G0 -ffreestanding -fno-pic -mno-shared -mno-abicalls -O2 -fno-stack-protector -I/app/mips_runtime/include -DNORMALUNIX -DLINUX -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE"
SRC_DIR=/app/doomgeneric/doomgeneric
BUILD=/tmp/mipsbuild
mkdir -p $BUILD
OBJS=""
for f in am_map doomdef doomstat dstrings d_event d_items d_iwad d_loop d_main d_mode d_net f_finale f_wipe g_game hu_lib hu_stuff info i_cdmus i_endoom i_joystick i_scale i_sound i_system i_timer memio m_argv m_bbox m_cheat m_config m_controls m_fixed m_menu m_misc m_random p_ceilng p_doors p_enemy p_floor p_inter p_lights p_map p_maputl p_mobj p_plats p_pspr p_saveg p_setup p_sight p_spec p_switch p_telept p_tick p_user r_bsp r_data r_draw r_main r_plane r_segs r_sky r_things sha1 sounds statdump st_lib st_stuff s_sound tables v_video wi_stuff w_checksum w_file w_main w_wad z_zone w_file_stdc i_input i_video doomgeneric doomgeneric_img dummy; do
  echo "CC $f"
  $CC $CFLAGS -c $SRC_DIR/$f.c -o $BUILD/$f.o
done
echo "CC mini_libc"
$CC $CFLAGS -fno-builtin -c /app/mips_runtime/mini_libc.c -o $BUILD/mini_libc.o
 echo "LINK"
$CC -EL -march=mips1 -msoft-float -G0 -ffreestanding -nostdlib -fno-pic -mno-shared -mno-abicalls -O2 -T /app/mips_runtime/link.ld $BUILD/*.o /usr/lib/gcc-cross/mipsel-linux-gnu/11/libgcc.a -o /app/doomgeneric_mips
mipsel-linux-gnu-readelf -S /app/doomgeneric_mips | head -n 40
mipsel-linux-gnu-nm /app/doomgeneric_mips | grep -E " main$| _end|heap" | head
EOS
chmod +x /app/build_mips.sh
/app/build_mips.sh 2>&1 | tail -n 100
